card.desc: A message arrived. Bright, two-tone, unmistakably digital.
card.prompt: a short bright two-tone digital notification chime, clean synthesised bell, dry
card.negative: music, melody, speech, reverb, long tail, alarm siren
card.note: Two tones, not a melody. Ask for more notes and it becomes a ringtone.

peak_limited.why: audition copy had no peak ceiling; the film bus already limits to -3 dBTP
